title: User-controlled SQL and file paths
description: A compact Python review scenario containing two independently labeled security defects.

expected_issues.title: SQL injection in user lookup
expected_issues.description: The username is interpolated directly into SQL rather than passed as a bound parameter.

expected_issues.title: Path traversal in note reader
expected_issues.description: An untrusted note name can escape the intended root because the joined path is not resolved and constrained beneath root.
